newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania names new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Albania names new prime minister.

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha appointed a new prime minister on Tuesday as armed unrest continued in the south of the country.

Bashkim Fino, an economist from the southern town of Gjirokaster and a member of the main opposition Socialist Party, replaces Aleksander Meksi, a member of the ruling Democratic Party, who resigned last month as the unrest erupted.
Fino's appointment was announced on state television as Berisha and nine opposition parties held lengthy negotiations on the formation of a national unity government.

Unrest has erupted in the south, with angry citizens calling for Berisha's resignation following the collapse of pyramid investment schemes that wiped out the savings of hundreds of thousands of ordinary Albanians.

The appointment of a member of the Socialist party to the premiership was seen as a concession to the opposition, although they have little or no influence over the highly localised rebel groups in the south.
Fino is a former mayor of Gjirokaster, one of the southern cities where unrest was first to break out.
